stem: What is the most likely reason Mrs. Nutmeg supports Becks joining Jasmine's campaign team?

options.label: A
options.text: She believes that Jasmine has the best chance of winning the election.

options.label: B
options.text: She wants Jasmine to feel welcome in a new school.

options.label: C
options.text: She is unaware that Brianna wants Becks on her campaign team.

options.label: D
options.text: She wants Becks to have an opportunity to be a campaign manager.
